lines.native: ¡Hola! Estoy aquí. Riddle: what has—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Your attention span? Huge potential. ♪ ¡Después, después, mañana! ♪
lines.translation: Hello! I'm here. Riddle: what has—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Your attention span? Huge potential. ♪ Later, later, tomorrow! ♪
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with municipal confidence. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker files a complaint about your attention.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! Pero sigo en movimiento. You told me to look, not stop. Riddle: what never stays—ooh, smoke. Can you make me stop moving? ♪ ¡Después, después, mañana! ♪
lines.translation: Yes, I’m looking! But I’m still moving. You told me to look, not stop. Riddle: what never stays—ooh, smoke. Can you make me stop moving? ♪ Later, later, tomorrow! ♪
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability cannot reach.

lines.native: ¡Vale, estoy quieto! Your attention span: suspiciously effective. ¿Por dónde voy? Riddle: what has two paths and—oh, a spark. Tú decides. Just five more minutes. ♪ ¡Después, después, mañana! ♪
lines.translation: Okay, I’m staying still! Your attention span: suspiciously effective. Which way do I go? Riddle: what has two paths and—oh, a spark. You decide. Just five more minutes. ♪ Later, later, tomorrow! ♪
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues moving on its behalf. Ahead, the corridor forks; neither branch has applied for responsibility.

lines.native: ¿En inglés? No, no. Necesito una dirección en español. Riddle: where does a path—ooh, your shoe. Your attention span: buffering. ¿Por dónde voy? Tenemos tiempo. Just five more minutes. ♪ ¡Después, después, mañana! ♪
lines.translation: In English? No, no. I need a direction in Spanish. Riddle: where does a path—ooh, your shoe. Your attention span: buffering. Which way do I go? We have time. Just five more minutes. ♪ Later, later, tomorrow! ♪
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where supervision is technically impossible.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! Muy bien. Pero vamos después. Tengo una pregunta: ¿qué tiene dos—ooh, a spark. Just five more minutes. ¿Cuándo quieres ir? ♪ ¡Después, después, mañana! ♪
lines.translation: To the left, yes! Very good. But we'll go later. I have a question: what has two—ooh, a spark. Just five more minutes. When do you want to go? ♪ Later, later, tomorrow! ♪
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, remaining inconveniently at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops where it ought to have been.

lines.native: ¡Sí! Mañana. Hoy no vamos. Your attention span: on vacation. ¿Cuándo quieres ir de verdad? Riddle: what waits forever and—ooh, smoke. ♪ ¡Después, después, mañana! ♪
lines.translation: Yes! Tomorrow. We aren't going today. Your attention span: on vacation. When do you really want to go? Riddle: what waits forever and—ooh, smoke. ♪ Later, later, tomorrow! ♪
lines.narrative: Flick's jingle acquires a second voice. This is how procrastination forms a committee. A tiny firecracker pops just outside your field of vision.

lines.native: ¡Ahora! Sí, muy bien. No mañana. Tú vas ahora; yo voy… después. Your attention span: deeply inconvenient. ¿Qué tiene dos pies y—ooh, a leaf. ♪ ¡Después, después, mañana! ♪
lines.translation: Now! Yes, very good. Not tomorrow. You go now; I go… later. Your attention span: deeply inconvenient. What has two feet and—ooh, a leaf. ♪ Later, later, tomorrow! ♪
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, apparently hoping the present will leave without it.
